boundary_policy: Assign a fresh boundary only after the child adapter and deterministic fixture pass.
common_falsification: Reject if development economics fail, fixed-first25 random-entry or direction-inversion hard control fails, required source lineage is not timestamp-safe, or sealed OOS/stress gates fail.

anchor_vwap_trend.operational_definition: Keep the closed-bar anchored-VWAP reclaim and EMA alignment unchanged; permit a signal only when signal_ts UTC hour is 13, 14, or 15.

bb_revert.operational_definition: Keep the Bollinger reclaim and existing EMA55 slope non-trend rule unchanged; require the completed signal-bar volume to be at least the median of the preceding 20 completed bars.

break_and_continue.operational_definition: Keep the 20-bar breakout, 8-bar box, EMA21/55 alignment and anti-chase rules unchanged; require signal-bar volume divided by mean volume of the preceding 20 completed bars to be at least 1.0.

fvg_revert.operational_definition: Keep the three-bar gap, direction, ATR stop, target and timeout unchanged; require completed signal-bar volume to be at least the median of the preceding 20 completed bars.

range_fade.operational_definition: Keep range position, RSI reclaim and exits unchanged; compute completed-bar Amihud proxy abs(log(close/prev_close))/(close*volume) and require it not to exceed the median of the preceding 20 completed bars.

rsi_swing_fail.operational_definition: Keep 20-bar swing failure, RSI and exits unchanged; exclude a signal when its absolute completed-bar log return exceeds the outcome-blind 99th percentile of the preceding 8640 completed 5-minute bars, computed without the signal bar.

scalp_snap.operational_definition: Keep the 5-minute impulse/reversal geometry and exits unchanged; compute Cont-style best-level order-flow imbalance from timestamped pre-entry book events over the signal bar, divide by mean contemporaneous bid-plus-ask depth, and require positive sign for long or negative sign for short.

session_bias.operational_definition: Keep the 24-bar range expansion, EMA21/55, ATR regime, anti-chase and exits unchanged; permit a completed signal only when signal_ts UTC hour is 13, 14, or 15.
